meta.scope: Live site (5 Nov 2026 build) and local production build (3 pages, ready to deploy)
data_sources: Crawl of local build (http://127.0.0.1:4173, 3 pages, 17 assets)
curl/OpenSSL checks of the live site
Lighthouse 12.6.1 mobile and desktop lab runs (Google Analytics blocked during testing)
not_measured: Real-user Core Web Vitals (CrUX): no Google API credentials configured
Search Console indexation and queries: no credentials configured
GA4 organic traffic: no credentials configured
Lighthouse Agentic Browsing category: not available in Lighthouse 12.6.1

summary.business_type: Pre-launch direct-to-consumer hardware (wearable health bracelet), pre-order e-commerce, EU/EUR
top_findings: Live site is still the 5 Nov build: non-www canonical/sitemap, duplicate https://pulzfit.com (200), FAQ answers missing from HTML, Product-only schema
Server: no JS/CSS compression, no asset caching, HTTP/1.1, no security headers (Nginx changes drafted, awaiting SSH access)
Weak trust signals for a health product: no About/team, no Privacy Policy or Terms (GA4 runs for EU visitors), no source for accuracy claims
No third-party brand presence found (no reviews, press, social profiles, video)
Mobile LCP 3.5-3.8 s in lab on the local build (8.2 s on live); target 2.5 s
quick_wins: Deploy the local build (fixes canonical, schema, FAQ visibility, images, fonts, LCP animation)
Apply the Nginx draft: apex 301 to www, gzip, cache headers, HTTP/2, security headers
Resubmit sitemap in Search Console and request indexing for the 3 URLs
Import the site into Bing Webmaster Tools from Search Console
Publish Privacy Policy and Terms pages (text needed from you)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Prerendered static HTML: all content, title, canonical and JSON-LD present without JavaScript
robots.txt allows all crawlers; sitemap lists 3 pages with per-page lastmod (local build)
Self-referencing www canonicals on all pages (local build)
HTTPS with valid Let's Encrypt cert for apex + www until 3 Feb 2027; TLS 1.2/1.3
http to https://www redirect is a single 301; real 404s for unknown URLs
No back-button hijacking (no history.pushState/replaceState); no mixed content
Multi-page prerender with noindex support and per-route metadata

findings.title: https://pulzfit.com serves a duplicate of the site (200)
findings.description: Live: apex HTTPS returns 200 with identical content; live canonical and sitemap point to the apex, opposite to the www plan.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the local build (www canonical) and add the apex-to-www 301 in Nginx.

findings.title: JS/CSS served uncompressed; no cache headers on hashed assets
findings.description: Only HTML is gzipped. Lighthouse estimates 475 KiB compression savings and 888 KiB cache savings on live.
findings.recommendation: gzip_types for JS/CSS/SVG/JSON; Cache-Control immutable for /assets/.

findings.title: HTTP/1.1 only
findings.description: All requests negotiate HTTP/1.1.
findings.recommendation: listen 443 ssl http2 on the PulzFit server block.

findings.title: No security headers; Nginx version exposed
findings.description: No HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy; Server: nginx/1.18.0 (Ubuntu) in headers and error pages.
findings.recommendation: Add headers (no CSP yet, so GA4/Firebase are unaffected) and server_tokens off.

findings.title: /index.html duplicates /
findings.description: Returns 200; canonical mitigates.
findings.recommendation: Redirect via $request_uri match (draft avoids a redirect loop).

findings.title: Ubuntu 20.04 / Nginx 1.18 past standard support
findings.description: Affects the whole VPS including FioraHouse.
findings.recommendation: Confirm ESM security updates or plan an OS upgrade.

findings.title: IndexNow not implemented
findings.description: Bing/Yandex/Naver discovery is slower.
findings.recommendation: Add a key file and ping on deploy.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage 1,444 words; ECG guide 784 words; features hub 454 words; all >= 67% unique vs each other
109-word 'What is PulzFit?' answer block at 5% of the homepage plus an 11-row specs table
ECG guide states limits clearly (cannot detect heart attack, not continuous, not a diagnosis)
Readability around Flesch 51 / US grade 8 on the homepage
Overclaiming removed ('medical-grade', '17+ dimensions', 'cardiologist' comparison)

findings.title: No About/team page or named experts
findings.description: Health (YMYL) product with anonymous authorship.
findings.recommendation: About page with founders and any clinical/engineering advisors; Person schema.

findings.title: No Privacy Policy or Terms
findings.description: GA4 via Firebase runs for EU visitors; legal and trust requirement.
findings.recommendation: Publish both pages (text needed), add footer links, consider cookie consent.

findings.title: Accuracy claims unsourced
findings.description: FAQ claims +/-2 BPM and +/-2% SpO2 without method or reference device.
findings.recommendation: Add a validation summary (method, reference device, sample, date).

findings.title: ECG guide medical wording needs expert review
findings.description: General ECG statements are conservative but should be checked; app-flow details need confirming.
findings.recommendation: Review by a qualified person before deploy.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles 44-54 chars and descriptions 151-156 chars on all 3 pages
Exactly one H1 per page; no skipped heading levels
Keyword-bearing H2s (Sleep tracking, ECG and HRV, PulzFit FAQ, What is PulzFit?)
Each page linked from both other pages; breadcrumbs on inner pages
No dead or misleading footer links

findings.title: Two titles under 50 characters
findings.description: /features/ (46) and /features/ecg/ (44).
findings.recommendation: Optional: extend, e.g. 'PulzFit ECG: Single-Lead Heart Rhythm Checks on Your Wrist'.

findings.title: No outbound links to authoritative sources
findings.description: Health guide cites no external references.
findings.recommendation: Link to a reputable explainer on ECG/arrhythmia once reviewed.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Homepage: Organization (contactPoint), WebPage, WebSite, Product (+9 additionalProperty specs, PreOrder Offer), FAQPage
Inner pages: WebPage + BreadcrumbList; ECG adds FAQPage matching visible text
All absolute URLs, resolved @id references, JSON-LD in initial HTML

findings.title: Product lacks shippingDetails / hasMerchantReturnPolicy / GTIN
findings.description: Recommended for merchant listings.
findings.recommendation: Fill from real policy; template in docs/seo/generated-schema.json.

findings.title: No Organization sameAs
findings.description: No social profiles exist yet.
findings.recommendation: Add once profiles exist.

findings.title: Live site has Product only, apex URLs
findings.description: Fixed in local build.
findings.recommendation: Deploy.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop lab: performance 100, LCP 0.7 s, CLS 0.001
CLS <= 0.02 and TBT <= 10 ms on all pages
Hero entrance is CSS (visible on first paint); fonts self-hosted; WebP images

findings.title: Mobile lab LCP 3.5-3.8 s (local), 8.2 s (live)
findings.description: Local preview has no compression; live lacks compression/HTTP2/caching. Real-user data not measured.
findings.recommendation: Deploy + Nginx changes, then re-measure; consider responsive srcset for the hero.

findings.title: ~120 KiB unused JavaScript
findings.description: Mostly Framer Motion on below-the-fold sections.
findings.recommendation: Lazy-load below-the-fold animation code.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Applebot, bingbot) allowed and served 200
Self-contained answer block and specs table high on the page
llms.txt generated (no ranking weight)

findings.title: No third-party brand mentions found
findings.description: No press, reviews, Reddit, YouTube or social presence.
findings.recommendation: LinkedIn page, YouTube walkthrough, launch press kit, reviewer units.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All content images WebP, 29-104 KB, with width/height
Hero preloaded with fetchpriority=high; others lazy-loaded
1200x630 social image, favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon

findings.title: 3 inactive carousel images have empty alt
findings.description: Intentional for hidden slides.
findings.recommendation: Optional: descriptive alt plus aria-hidden on inactive slides.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Authorise SSH key, then deploy dist/ with backup
Apply Nginx draft after nginx -t: apex 301, gzip, caching, HTTP/2, security headers, /index.html redirect
Verify live: canonical, sitemap, 3 pages, headers, FioraHouse unaffected, GA4 page views
Search Console: resubmit sitemap, request indexing for /, /features/, /features/ecg/

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Privacy Policy and Terms pages (your text)
About page with founders and Person schema
Expert review of ECG guide wording

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Next feature guides: sleep tracking, HRV, SpO2, family care
LinkedIn company page, YouTube walkthrough, sameAs links
Launch press kit and reviewer outreach

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Configure Google API credentials for CrUX/GSC/GA4 data
Monthly: indexed pages vs sitemap, CWV, GSC queries
Quarterly: re-verify specs, prices and claims; update page dates
